data.title: 霍尔海雅 · 丝绒暮夜的呢喃
data.action: 侧卧在红丝绒金边贵妃榻上蛇尾缠绕大腿慵懒回眸微笑
data.lighting: 落地窗外繁华都市夜景光斑与室内琥珀色暖光交织的轮廓光
data.description: 暮色降临，高层套房的落地窗外亮起繁华都市的璀璨光斑。霍尔海雅斜倚在复古红丝绒贵妃榻上，一袭半透视黑蕾丝薄纱睡裙勾勒出曼妙起伏的曲线，翠鳞蛇尾亲昵而慵懒地缠上修长双腿。她轻托香腮，青色蛇眸泛着微醺与试探的波光，朝你嫣然一笑——「长夜漫漫，这个故事的后半段……要近一点听吗？」
data.promptProse: In a dimly lit high-rise suite at twilight, Ho'olheyak reclines on her side along a crimson velvet chaise lounge, propping her chin on one hand while her snake tail coils lazily around her stockinged legs. Through the tall panoramic window behind her, bokeh of evening city lights shimmers beside sheer drapes and a crystal wine glass on the side table. Warm amber room light rims her grey hair, feathered head wings, and sheer black lace as she meets the viewer's gaze with a knowing smile.
data.animaCaption: Reclining on her side along the crimson velvet chaise in her sheer black lace babydoll and garter-held thighhighs, Ho'olheyak props her chin on one hand as her snake tail coils around her legs. Warm interior light and sparkling city bokeh beyond the tall window catch her playful, knowing smile.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sheer black lace babydoll negligee with a plunging neckline revealing deep cleavage and bare shoulders, paired with garter straps and sheer black thighhighs.
